# Packages installed into the Debian 13 (trixie) arm64 root filesystem.
# One package per line; comments and blank lines are ignored.  Everything is
# installed with --no-install-recommends, so anything actually wanted from a
# "Recommends:" line has to be listed here explicitly.
#
